representative_semantics.classification: Explicit ASTIS total representative extension; source itself is silent on uncovered input/time pairs.
representative_semantics.uncovered_fallback: Use the same z0 parameter as phase value exactly when no actual covering interval exists. This coordinate projection is jointly measurable. The fallback is not called the source state on exceptional inputs.
representative_semantics.covered_points: Use actual record n=Sum.inl(a) and finite t-a.time in Phi. A selected interval has finite left clock, so stopped records cannot supply phase. The source formula is characterized on all covered points, or at minimum on the per-parameter common AE all-time covering event.
representative_semantics.infinite_wait: A next waiting time of top does not trigger fallback: the last live interval covers all later finite t and uses its actual stored finite phase/time.
representative_semantics.exceptional_zero_thresholds: A covered point at t0 may occur after one or more zero-time bounces on a clamped-zero exceptional sample; uncovered accumulating zero-time records may instead invoke fallback. Therefore literal covered-arc agreement plus this fallback does not yield Z0=z0 for every real sequence.
representative_semantics.uniqueness: Do not claim a unique total function on all samples. Two source-agreeing representatives can only be identified on a per-parameter common AE all-time event unless their exceptional conventions are also fixed.
